title: Environment patches
summary: Settings → Environments shows every environment's version (even when matching the client) and its installed patches in both Map and List views. Map cards display '<version> · <N> patches', and each environment row adds a 'Patches' disclosure beside Routes and Permissions that lists every patch's title, version badge, slug, summary, and an expandable 'What’s included' feature breakdown, preserving open state across Map ↔ List switches. Servers publish their patches on ExecutionEnvironmentDescriptor (and t3_environment_read) from T3_PATCHER_PATCHES baked at build time or <stateDir>/patcher/installed.json.

journeys.name: environment_patches
journeys.proves: The built app pairs a second headless T3 server on the same version whose installed.json lists two patches (including Picks with multi-sentence included features); in Settings → Environments Map view, both machines' map cards show '<version> · 2 patches', selecting the remote machine shows its matching version and expands '2 patches' and Picks's 'What’s included' bullets; switching to List view shows the local machine under This app with its baked patches, keeps the remote machine's version and expanded 'What’s included' state intact, and switching the remote machine off shows 'Connect to view installed patches.'
